verdict.rationale: Xero is an API-accessible accounting SaaS with SDKs and an official MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, demo company, test organisation, or any other way to isolate testing from production data. The items cover SDKs, the OpenAPI spec, the MCP server, Custom Connections and product features, none of which address test isolation.
